greeting: ^Fear not, I know ye did not mean to break me ship. Ye were just tryin' to help. Besides! A good pirate is never beaten without a ship.
^We'll look for some ship parts to build ye a grand vessel!
^Aye, the waves here are always going to be rough, but I picked up a trick along the way!
^When the waves are tough, I try to breathe along with the tide!
^Breathe in like the ship going up, right to the top! Breathing out while ye descend. It be like yer one with the waves.
farewell: ^That's the spirit! Keep remindin' yerself of that.
^Yer a chip off the old block, ye'll make a great pirate in no time. Good luck, Captain!
